summary: Arbutus Biopharma filed an 8-K announcing a modified Dutch auction tender offer to repurchase up to US$230 million of its common shares at a price between US$5.00 and US$5.75 per share. The offer has not yet commenced; the company will file a Schedule TO with the SEC and Canadian regulators. This is an issuer self-tender, not a third-party offer. Shareholders should review the offer documents when available. Watch for the commencement date and final pricing, which will determine the number of shares tendered and potential proration.
